subject: ela
intro: Pick the media that enhance a presentation.

items.prompt:
Something the audience SEES is a:
A) visual
B) audio
C) snack

Something the audience HEARS is:
A) a visual
B) audio
C) a chair

Presenting on renewable energy, the BEST visual is:
A) a diagram of how a wind turbine works
B) a photo of your lunch
C) a menu
items.answer: A) a diagram of how a wind turbine works

steps: Supports the topic. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a diagram of how a wind turbine works

items.prompt:
For a presentation about musical instruments, what would help the audience most?
A) short audio clips of the instruments
B) a silent photo only
C) a blank page
items.answer: A) short audio clips of the instruments

steps: Audio lets them hear. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) short audio clips of the instruments

items.prompt:
Multimedia in a presentation should be used to:
A) enhance the main ideas or themes
B) distract the audience
C) replace the whole talk
items.answer: A) enhance the main ideas or themes

steps: Enhance the point. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) enhance the main ideas or themes

items.prompt:
To compare the energy output of three power sources, the BEST visual is a:
A) bar graph
B) poem
C) joke

steps: Bar graphs compare. Key is A.

items.prompt:
You present on volcanoes. Which set of multimedia BEST enhances your main ideas?
A) A diagram of a volcano, a map of volcanic zones, and a short eruption video
B) A photo of your pet
C) No media at all
items.answer: A) A diagram of a volcano, a map of volcanic zones, and a short eruption video

steps: On topic and informative. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) A diagram of a volcano, a map of volcanic zones, and a short eruption video

items.prompt:
A visual or multimedia element enhances a presentation only when it:
A) supports the main idea and can be clearly seen or heard
B) is unrelated
C) replaces all the speaking
items.answer: A) supports the main idea and can be clearly seen or heard

steps: Relevant and clear. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) supports the main idea and can be clearly seen or heard
